The Joy vibe will
create a cyclone!

(Hold the button to

make you cry! You can

called...

to slide!

spots with this move!

original:
Strange mushrooms
and odd flowers up

something about

and odd flowers up
ahead... There's

original:
Huh? What a weak-
looking bridge.
Looks like it'd burn
easily, so don't get 
mad standing on it!
translation:
Huh? What a weak-
looking bridge.
Looks like it'd burn
easily, so don't get 
mad standing on it!

Those blue things
fall when you cross
at normal speed, so
you have to find a 
way to cross quickly!
[1:000300][1:000100]
Why not try one of 
your vibes?

Those blue things
fall when you cross
at normal speed, so
you have to find a

Why not try one of 
your vibes?

original:
What's that strange-
looking fluff?

try a cyclone!

to try your vibes!

What's that strange-
looking fluff?
It looks like it's 
made of clouds, so
try a cyclone!

to try your vibes!

original:
Huh? Too many bats
for you to pass?
I think I recall that
bats hate fire!
translation:
Huh? Too many bats
for you to pass?
I think I recall that
bats hate fire!

Did you know?
When there's a Toad
or an item in an
area, you can tell!
[1:000300][1:000100]

walks in, an "!" 
will appear!

see an "!"
translation:

When there's a Toad

The beach reminds me
of the day that girl
built a sand castle.

mix water with sand!

boss of this place,
the owl. When it
swoops, aim for its
head and stomp on it!
[1:000300][1:000100]
You think it's got an
advantage in the air?
But you can use Joy
to fly higher than
even it can and...
[1:000300][1:000100]

is directly beneath
you to stomp on it!

original:
There's a huge Boo up
ahead! Aren't ghosts
scared of light?
[1:000300][1:000100]
You've got to make
the room bright! I
bet you could break
the chandelier if you
smashed it...

There's a huge Boo up
ahead! Aren't ghosts
scared of light?
[1:000300][1:000100]
You've got to make
the room bright! I
bet you could break
the chandelier if you
smashed it...

original:
There's a huge
Wiggler ahead! Maybe
if you get mad and
stomp on the springs
on the ground...
[1:000300][1:000100]
Yeah! Then you'd
just have to stomp
its weak spot when
it flips!
[1:000300][1:000100]
If you let the smoke
stay, you'll take
damage. Blow it away
with a cyclone!

There's a huge
Wiggler ahead! Maybe
if you get mad and
stomp on the springs

[1:000300][1:000100]

its weak spot when
it flips!
[1:000300][1:000100]

original:
There's a huge
Blooper up ahead!
After defeating its
legs, hit its mouth!
[1:000300][1:000100]
Clean its ink with
water, and if it
falls asleep, pop its
bubble as quickly as 
possible!

There's a huge
Blooper up ahead!
After defeating its
legs, hit its mouth!
[1:000300][1:000100]
Clean its ink with
water, and if it
falls asleep, pop its
bubble as quickly as 
possible!

of this place, a

[1:000300][1:000100]
Normal attacks won't
work... What works
against ice?

Up ahead is the boss
of this place, a
dragon. It's encased

original:
There's a giant
magician up ahead...
Wind is his weakness,
so attack his head
with a cyclone...
[1:000300][1:000100]
When he's dizzy, 
that's your chance!
I hate magicians!
GRRRRRRRR!

There's a giant
magician up ahead...
Wind is his weakness,
so attack his head
with a cyclone...

that's your chance!
I hate magicians!
GRRRRRRRR!

water that we can't
pass! You might be

that uses fire to
float in the air.
